caption: A tall wooden lifeguard chair stands on a beach with the low sun behind it, and its long shadow stretches across the sand in front of it.

sa.check: A tall wooden lifeguard chair stands on a beach.
The sun is low behind it.
Its long shadow stretches across the sand in front of it.
The shadow is longer than the chair is tall.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the ground away from the sun and starts at the chair's legs.
pc.fail: It points toward the sun; or it floats detached from the legs; or it is missing under a plainly low sun.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the chair's outline, stretched long by the low sun.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or it is short under a low sun; or it splits into two.

pc.expect: The shadow stays still with the chair still.
pc.fail: It drifts across the sand by itself; or it changes length with nothing moving; or it swings round.

pc.expect: The chair stands on the sand and the shadow lies flat on it.
pc.fail: The chair floats; or the shadow stands up off the sand; or the shadow climbs the chair.

pc.expect: One chair and one shadow; the chair keeps its parts.
pc.fail: The chair duplicates or vanishes; or a second shadow appears; or the shadow becomes solid; or a leg vanishes.

pc.expect: The chair's paint and the beach stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The chair changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the sand texture changes.
